motion_provenance.source: ExRx 'Dumbbell Hammer Curl' (target brachioradialis; synergists brachialis, biceps brachii)

motion_provenance.what: muscle roles (target -> primary, synergists -> secondary, stabilizers -> stabilizing)

start_position: Stand tall, feet about hip width
Arms by the sides, palms facing in
concentric: Bend the elbows, thumbs up the whole way
Keep the upper arms by the sides
eccentric: Lower under control until the arms are almost straight

validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.
validation_profile.max_hand_into_bar_comment: The skin of the palm is rigid in this rig. Up to 8 mm of palm pad inside the bar stands for soft tissue pressed flat by the load; more than that, or any finger passing through the bar, is a defect.

technical_cues: Palms face each other from bottom to top
common_mistakes: Turning the palms up (that is a biceps curl)
muscle_roles_note: Three levels (Kiệt 15/11): primary = carries the load and produces the main force; secondary = directly assists the movement; stabilizing = holds posture and keeps joints stable. Neutral grip: brachioradialis is the target (ExRx), biceps and the hidden brachialis assist. Anterior deltoid and upper trapezius stabilise.
